# CI/CD Status Badges for README.md

Add these badges to your README.md to show the CI/CD status:

```markdown
## Build Status

[![CI/CD](https://github.com/snickler/social-media-command/actions/workflows/ci-cd.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/snickler/social-media-command/actions/workflows/ci-cd.yml)
[![Code Quality](https://github.com/snickler/social-media-command/actions/workflows/code-quality.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/snickler/social-media-command/actions/workflows/code-quality.yml)
[![Release](https://github.com/snickler/social-media-command/actions/workflows/release.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/snickler/social-media-command/actions/workflows/release.yml)

## Downloads

The latest releases are available for all supported platforms:

- **Windows** (x64, arm64): `.exe` executables
- **Linux** (x64, arm64): AppImage packages and executables  
- **macOS** (x64, arm64): `.app` bundles

[Download Latest Release](https://github.com/snickler/social-media-command/releases/latest)
```

## Key Features of the CI/CD Pipeline:

- ✅ **Multi-platform builds** for Windows, Linux, and macOS
- ✅ **Multi-architecture support** (x64, arm64)
- ✅ **Automated testing** with 184+ unit tests
- ✅ **Code coverage reporting** in pull requests
- ✅ **Security scanning** with CodeQL
- ✅ **Dependency management** with Dependabot
- ✅ **Semantic versioning** with automated releases
- ✅ **Professional packaging** (AppImage, app bundles, executables)
